beats.en: After the Kushanas and Satavahanas new kingdoms arose, and the new actor on the stage was the Gupta dynasty, which gave the period lasting importance.
beats.speakEn: After the Kushanas and Satavahanas new kingdoms arose, and the new actor on the stage was the Gupta dynasty, which gave the period lasting importance.

beats.en: Rather than controlling everything from a central authority, the Guptas divided the empire into provinces and granted land to local rulers, priests and chieftains.
